Commentary: Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, no run, left alone! Just short of good length outside off from Byron McDonough, Sediqullah Atal sees the line and decides to leave it alone

Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, leading edge, and just wide of the fielder at cover-point! Fullish on the stumps, and Sediqullah Atal tries to work it to the on side but closes the face of the bat a bit too early. Gets a thick leading edge that goes to the right of the fielder, who dives but can't get to the ball
Byron McDonough to Ibrahim Zadran, FOUR, easy pickings for Ibrahim Zadran! Short without much pace on it and Ibrahim Zadran is happy to swivel across and pull it to deep square leg for a boundary
Byron McDonough to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, full and outside off, Ibrahim Zadran inner halves the drive back to the bowler
Mark Adair to Sediqullah Atal, no run, tailing into the batter from round the wicket, but the line is just wide enough for Sediqullah Atal to offer no shot
Mark Adair to Sediqullah Atal, no run, full and around off, Sediqullah Atal takes a big step forward and eases it to the fielder at mid-off
Mark Adair to Sediqullah Atal, no run, big movement away from the length, Sediqullah Atal throws his bat at it, only to meet with nothing but thin air
Mark Adair to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, shaping into the batter with the angle and it's on the shorter side, Sediqullah Atal gets inside the line and works it to fine leg for an easy single
Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, a tad shorter outside off, Ibrahim Zadran stands tall and steers it to deep third man before scampering across to the other end

Mark Adair to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, short and wide from Mark Adair. Sediqullah Atal gets into position to play the cut but plays it half-heartedly, gets a thick edge, and the ball flies to third man, who moves to his left and keeps it to one
Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, no run, some extra bounce and movement on offer for Byron McDonough. Sediqullah Atal wanted to slash it through the off-side but fails to get any bat to it
Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, no run, Byron McDonough brings his line closer and fuller to Sediqullah Atal, who shoulders arms

Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, FOUR, glanced away to fine leg with ease! On the pads, and all Sediqullah Atal had to do was get some bat to it. The ball runs away for a boundary, beating deep backward square leg
Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, no run, into the body and the left-hander turns it to the fielder at square leg

Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, no run, full and shaping away from Byron McDonough. Sediqullah Atal looks to slice it through the point region but gets an under-edge that goes through to the keeper on one bounce
Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, no run, going away with the angle from the length, Sediqullah Atal offers no shot
Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, tries to block it on the front foot but ends up getting an inside edge onto the pads, and the ball drops in front of the bowler on his follow-through

Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, oh hello, that keeps low, but lucky for Ibrahim Zadran that the line is outside off. The right-hander attempts a back foot punch on this length delivery but is beaten by the lack of bounce
Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, FOUR, short and pulled away by Ibrahim Zadran!
Mark Adair to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, to third man

Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
One slip in place for Liam McCarthy
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, goes full and on the stumps on this occasion, Ibrahim Zadran watches it closely and defends it with a straight bat
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, FOUR, to deep extra cover
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, leg byes, 1 run
Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, 2 runs, to backward square leg

Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, half-volley outside off from Curtis Campher, Ibrahim Zadran is happy to come forward and push it to sweeper cover for a single
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, FOUR, oh no, that's a fumble at sweeper cover and it goes for four!
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, to square leg
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, full and driven to the left of cover. The fielder dives and make a good stop, saving three runs for his team
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, no run
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, missing leg!
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, sharp bumper from Liam McCarthy! Puts in a bit more effort and drops it short close to off, Ibrahim Zadran goes for the pull but makes no connection
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, Liam McCarthy is making Ibrahim Zadran a bit uncomfortable with his pace and bounce.
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, short again but Ibrahim Zadran does well to pull it to deep square leg for a single
Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, no run
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, FOUR, that's a good shot!
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, FOUR, streaky, but Ibrahim Zadran wouldn't care!
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, rides the bounce on this back of a length delivery outside off and opens the face of the blade to guide it to deep third man for a single
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, to cover
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, no run

Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, no run
Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, to point
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, similar length but slightly away from the batter, who taps it to sweeper cover for a single
Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, no run, fends, and beaten!
Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, no ball
Liam McCarthy to Sediqullah Atal, FOUR, to square third man
Gavin Hoey, right-arm leg break, comes into the attack
Gavin Hoey to Ibrahim Zadran, 2 runs, to fine leg
Gavin Hoey to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, to cover
Gavin Hoey to Sediqullah Atal, no run
Gavin Hoey to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, to cover point
Gavin Hoey to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, flighted on the stumps, Ibrahim Zadran presses forward and inside halves the block to square leg for one run
Gavin Hoey to Sediqullah Atal, no run, Sediqullah Atal stays deep inside the crease, moves across and defends this length delivery back to the bowler
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, short and wide from Liam McCarthy, Ibrahim Zadran stands on his toes and punches it straight to the point fielder
Liam McCarthy to Ibrahim Zadran, no run
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, back of a length close to off, Atal gets on top and punches to sweeper cover
Gavin Hoey to Sediqullah Atal, no run, flighted around off, Atal goes back and defends to mid-wicket
Gavin Hoey to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, very full and close to off, Atal squeezes it to mid-off and has to rush. That was a tight. A direct-hit might have been interesting
Gavin Hoey to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, tossed up on off, Zadran shapes to slog sweep and ends up dragging it to deep mid-wicket
Gavin Hoey to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, shortens the length around off, Atal knocks it wide of cover and rotates strike. The 100-run stand comes up..
Gavin Hoey to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, flighted outside off, Zadran eases it towards point
Gavin Hoey to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, drifts in and turns a bit, Zadran pushes it off the outer half to backward point
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, no run, back of a length delivery, Atal stays behind the line and defends solidly
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, leg byes, 1 run, strays down leg, Atal misses the tuck and the ball deflects off the thigh pad

Curtis Campher to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, back of a length and Zadran thought he could loft it over mid-off. The width was there but the bounce did not allow him to get on top, the outside-edge flies down to third man

Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, wide, sharp short delivery but it is sprayed down leg, Atal fails to help it along and there's a stifled appeal for a caught behind. Nothing from the umpire, he signals a wide..
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, no run, good length ball on off, Atal turns it with soft hands to mid-wicket
Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, no run, back of a length around off, Atal angles it to backward point

Curtis Campher to Sediqullah Atal, no run, ouch! That's hit Zadran at the other end. Full pitcher around off, Atal smashes the drive straight back. It was uppish and the ball was travelling. Zadran didn't have time to get out of the way and is struck on the hand. In fact, he got his hands up and evaded being hit near the mid-riff
The physio is out there. Some magic spray is being applied to the right hand. Zadran is fine and ready to continue..
Harry Tector, right-arm off break, comes into the attack
Harry Tector to Ibrahim Zadran, no run, floated up outside off, Zadran drives it back to Tector
Harry Tector to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, short and outside off, Zadran cracks it square of the wicket
Harry Tector to Sediqullah Atal, no run, bit of turn but the length is short, Atal rides the bounce and pats it to point
Harry Tector to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, to cover
Harry Tector to Ibrahim Zadran, 1 run, flatter delivery outside off, Zadran punches wide of long-off
Harry Tector to Sediqullah Atal, wide
Harry Tector to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, drifting in from round the wicket, Atal tucks it backward of square leg
Byron McDonough [4.0-0-21-1] is back into the attack
Byron McDonough to Sediqullah Atal, 1 run, full toss around off, Atal eases it towards mid-off

Byron McDonough to Ibrahim Zadran, FOUR, shot! Mid-off was up, length was full and Zadran just goes through the line. He had the width to free his hands and connects nicely with the lofted drive, couple of bounces and over the rope
Byron McDonough to Ibrahim Zadran, SIX, to deep mid-wicket
